services.name: Boat rental

Choose from our covered storage facilities and shrink-wrap dry storage to shield your boat from the harsh winter elements. Our full-service approach includes essential maintenance tasks such as: bottom wash, gear oil checks, fuel stabilizer application, and antifreeze services. quotes.author: Konstantin Khlobystov
quotes.text: Here's a review you might like: --- We had an exceptional experience at this marina! From the moment we arrived, the customer service was top-notch; the staff was incredibly friendly and helpful, making sure we had everything we needed for our fishing trip.

quotes.author: Vitaliy Latanskiy
quotes.text: I was looking for a spot to fish for bass from the shore line and this location was suggested by one of the forum on fishing in Ontario. Apparently Simcoe lake is very popular for bass fishing. We arrived mid day on rainy weekend and marine seemed to be empty. The owner was kind enough to let me park my car as there is not other parking spots around.

quotes.author: Hubert Nguyen
quotes.text: Went up there today to rent a 14 feet aluminum boat 15 horse power. The process was simple and easy to. The staffs were friendly and professional. Two prices: for half a day, four hour or full day 8 hours rental plus gas. The engine is small so it's quite efficient. We went for 4 hours with 2 hrs spent riding for scenic view and pictures but it was only a few bucks for gas.

quotes.author: guerebear
quotes.text: Beautiful view from the dock, great place to take a walk.
